question: A ball of mass $m$ moving with a horizontal velocity $v$ strikes the bob of mass $m$ of a pendulum at rest. During this collision, the ball sticks with the bob of the pendulum. The height to which the combined mass rises is ($g$ = acceleration due to gravity)
solution:
Perfectly inelastic collision: $mv = 2mV \Rightarrow V = \dfrac{v}{2}$.

Then energy is conserved while swinging up:
$$h = \frac{V^2}{2g} = \frac{v^2}{8g}$$
